title: Building – Requirement to provide schedules of Professional Involvement June 2015
description: An older commercial building used by a local establishment had structural and building-envelope deficiencies identified by a structural engineer (2012) and a building envelope engineer (2012), who recommended phased repairs. Their recommendations were not followed in a timely way.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an s.49 order

outcome_summary: Order varied into two options: stop occupancy until written permission, or take precautions and provide verification of the professionals of record and constructor, full engineer reviews per their Schedule A/B scope by 31 Jul 2015, and a revised permit for remediation.
